build_escnmd_moe_backbone: build an eSCNMDMoeBackbone model with 8 experts and softmax expert coefficient normalization
merge_mole_backbone: merge the eSCNMDMoeBackbone MOLE layers into a single linear layer for single-dataset inference
build_dataset_specific_moe_wrapper: build a DatasetSpecificMoEWrapper with a backbone and head class for dataset-specific expert routing
build_dataset_specific_single_head_wrapp: build a DatasetSpecificSingleHeadWrapper with a backbone and head class for shared-head multi-dataset prediction
review_mole_coefficients: review the set_MOLE_coefficients method to understand expert routing based on composition and CSD embeddings
